works.name: Hamilton
works.deck_en: A wedding revisited, two different paces of life, and a wife who refuses to remain a footnote to achievement.
works.deck_zh: 从一场重新展开的婚礼出发，听见不同的人生节奏，也听见不愿只为伟业让路的伴侣。
works.scope_en: This introduction draws on the official synopsis, creator and performer interviews, historical sources, and signed criticism. It concerns the original Broadway production’s narrative and creative choices, not a firsthand review of a live performance or a complete recording.
works.scope_zh: 本文依据官方剧情介绍、主创与演员访谈、历史资料及署名评论，讨论原版百老汇作品的叙事与创作安排，并非现场观剧或完整观看影像后的演出评论。

works.name: Hadestown
works.deck_en: Eurydice needs warmth now. What does the promise of safety ask her to surrender?
works.deck_zh: 欧律狄刻眼下就需要温暖。安全的许诺，要她交出什么？

works.name: Fun Home
works.deck_en: Three ages of Alison share a stage, without resolving her father or writing her mother out.
works.deck_zh: 三个年龄的Alison同处舞台，父亲未被彻底解释，母亲也不再只是背景。

works.name: Into the Woods
works.deck_en: When fairy-tale paths cross, one person’s happy ending may pass through someone else’s life.
works.deck_zh: 童话的道路交叉以后，一个人通向幸福的捷径，也可能横穿别人的生活。

works.name: Sunday in the Park with George
works.name_zh: 星期天与乔治同游公园
works.topic_en: Art & a life beyond the picture
works.deck_en: A model can leave the pose; an artist can outgrow the work others expect him to repeat.
works.deck_zh: 模特可以走出姿势，艺术家也不必一直重复别人认得出的作品。

works.name: Come From Away
works.deck_en: Food, telephones, prayer and waiting: hospitality begins by asking what this person needs.
works.deck_zh: 食物、电话、祈祷与等待：帮助从询问眼前这个人需要什么开始。

works.name: Cabaret
works.deck_en: A pineapple and an engagement reveal what fear does to a shared future. The 1998 stage version.
works.deck_zh: 一只菠萝与一场订婚，显出恐惧怎样改变共同的未来。以1998舞台版为准。

works.name: Company
works.deck_en: Everyone likes having Bobby around. Is there room for a life not organized around their needs?
works.deck_zh: 大家都喜欢鲍比来作伴，他自己的生活却该从哪里开始？

works.name: Next to Normal
works.topic_zh: 疾病、照顾与女儿的时间
works.deck_en: Natalie practices for a recital while her family’s needs occupy the room. Includes a major early revelation.
works.deck_zh: 娜塔莉练习钢琴，家人的需要却先占满了房间。涉及前段重要揭示。

works.name: Fiddler on the Roof
works.deck_en: Permission becomes a blessing, then a refusal: a father discovers that care does not settle every choice.
works.deck_zh: 从许可到祝福，再到拒绝：父亲逐渐发现，关心不能替女儿决定一切。

works.name: A Chorus Line
works.deck_en: An audition asks for life stories as well as dancing. What does a job entitle an employer to know?
works.deck_zh: 试镜不仅要看舞蹈，还要听人生。一份工作，给了雇主知道多少的权利？

works.name: Les Misérables
works.deck_en: A useful mayor learns that another man may be punished in his place. His good work cannot settle the question.
works.deck_zh: 一位有用的市长得知别人将替自己受罚。他的善行，不能替那个陌生人作答。

works.name: Wicked
works.deck_en: Glinda joins a dance before making Elphaba more acceptable. A friendship begins without sameness.
works.deck_zh: 格琳达先走进舞池，而不是先把艾尔法巴改得合群。友谊由此开始。

works.name: Sweeney Todd
works.deck_en: Lovett’s seaside dream sounds gentle. The people excluded from it reveal its cost.
works.deck_zh: 洛薇特的海边愿景听来温柔，那些不能进入图画的人，却显出它的代价。

works.name: The Light in the Piazza
works.deck_en: A mother knows the risks; her daughter has wishes of her own. Protection must learn to make room.
works.deck_zh: 母亲熟悉风险，女儿也有自己的愿望。保护还需要学习怎样留下空间。

works.name: Ordinary Days
works.deck_en: A lost notebook, a bottle of wine and things not thrown away: four New Yorkers try to hear one another.
works.deck_zh: 失而复得的笔记、一瓶酒与舍不得丢的旧物：四个纽约人试着听懂彼此。

works.name: West Side Story
works.deck_en: Tony wants another life, but his friends still claim him. Maria and Anita make the cost of belonging harder to ignore.
works.deck_zh: 托尼想过另一种生活，朋友却仍然要求他归队。玛丽亚与安妮塔让归属的代价更难被忽略。

works.name: Caroline, or Change
works.deck_en: A well-meant laundry rule makes a worker choose between need and shame. Why was it never a pay rise?
works.deck_zh: 一条善意的洗衣规则，使劳动者在需要与难堪之间选择。它为什么始终不是加薪？

works.name: The Band’s Visit
works.topic_zh: 一夜相处与未完的生活
works.deck_en: Stranded musicians share a desert town’s evening. A meeting can matter without changing everyone’s life.
works.deck_zh: 走错地方的乐手分享了一座沙漠小镇的夜晚。相遇不必改变一生，才算有意义。

works.name: Falsettos
works.deck_en: Marvin wants to keep everyone close. His family begins to grow when he can no longer assign all their places.
works.deck_zh: 马文想把大家都留在身边。当他不能再替所有人安排位置，家庭才开始变化。
